name: context-memory-manager
description: Gives Antigravity persistent memory about your projects. At every session start, the agent automatically reads PROJECT_CONTEXT.md and workspace architecture notes so it understands your codebase without needing explanations every time.
suggestedPrompts: Analyze my workspace and build a PROJECT_CONTEXT.md memory file for this project
Update my project knowledge base with the latest architectural decisions we made
Show me what you know about my current project from memory
